title:
Tabernacles
& Harvest
description:
Tabernacles / Harvest is the last of 3 annual pilgrimage harvest feasts to Yahweh. It is the last of the 7 annual feasts. This feast has two different symbolisms: 1) Tabernacles - dwelling in temporary tents 2) Harvest - Celebrating the bringing in of the fruit of the land
(Harvest is a metaphor for gathering people into God's kingdom - eg the sower, the seed and the crop)
